description:
The young master she loves is possessed by three lustful spirits?! When the judge's young master, Kim Shin-Woo, falls ill, Seo Dan-Ah, the daughter of a pharmacist who has been in love with him, visits his house late at night under the pretense of getting medicine. However, the young master is possessed by a grotesque lustful spirit...

 *"If you appease my sexual desire, I'll let him go."*

Dan-Ah spends the night with the lustful spirit after being told that the young master will be returned if she releases her grudge. However, the young master who comes to see her the next day is completely different in speech, personality, and even sexual orientation. A serpentine pornography, a lustful obsessed man, a lustful servant, and a lustful slave begging to be stepped on...

Can Dan-Ah, who has been helplessly swept up in a trio of lustful spirits, safely get her young master back?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)
